greeting.morning: Good morning — what shall we move forward today?
greeting.afternoon: Good afternoon — what shall we move forward today?
greeting.evening: Good evening — anything to wrap up or plan?

chat.title: AI Coach
chat.inputPlaceholder: What do you want to do?
chat.quotaBlocked: You've used this month's AI quota. You can still create tasks manually.
chat.contentFiltered: That message triggered the safety filter — try rephrasing.
chat.modelUnavailable: The AI is temporarily unavailable. Try again soon.
chat.voiceSendLater: Added to the input. Send it when the reply is done.
chat.recordingFailed: Could not start recording. Please try again.
chat.emptyAudio: No speech detected. Please try again.
chat.micPermissionBlocked: Allow microphone access in Settings to use voice input.
chat.micPermissionRequired: Microphone access is needed for voice input.
chat.micReady: Microphone ready. Tap again to speak.
chat.generationFailed: This reply could not be completed. Please try again or start a new conversation.
chat.clearDescription: Your messages, drafts and diagnostic traces will be permanently deleted. Thumbs up/down ratings and any reasons or details you submitted are kept for quality review.
chat.historyError: Could not load history — tap to retry
chat.busy: Wait for the current reply or save to finish.
chat.actionFailed: Could not update your chat. Please try again.

feedback.noteSavedTruncated: Saved to notes (long reply, first 2,000 characters kept)
feedback.noteSaveFailed: Couldn't save the note. Try again.
feedback.title: What could be better? (optional)

draft.saveFailed: Saving the task failed — the card is still here, you can retry.
draft.scheduleRequired: Set the date and times with the edit button before saving.
draft.scheduleConflictConfirm: This time overlaps an existing task. Save it anyway?
draft.scheduleChanged: The schedule changed. Review the latest conflict and try again.
draft.scheduleUnverified: The task calendar could not be checked. Try again later.
draft.schedulePartial: Repeats in the first seven days were checked; later dates have not been checked.
draft.editFailed: Could not update the draft. Please try again.
draft.timePassed: This time has passed — edit it before saving.

editModal.title: Edit task
editModal.endBeforeStart: End time must be after start time
editModal.interval: Every how many days, weeks, months or years?
editModal.dayOfMonth: Day of month (blank uses start date)
editModal.invalidRecurrence: Check the repeat interval, selected days and end date.

review.title: Review list
review.explanation: Items are saved to tasks and notes only when you add them.
review.noteTooLong: The title and note text together must be at most 2,000 characters.
review.saveFailed: Could not save. Your review list is still here.
review.invalidFields: Check the title, dates and times before adding.
review.changed: The list changed. Review the latest items and try again.
review.changedWhileEditing: The list changed while you were editing. Your changes are still here; return to the list to review its latest version.
review.confirmationUnknown: Checking whether your items were saved. Keep this request unchanged; retry if needed.
review.discardEditDescription: These edits have not been submitted. The original item will stay in the review list.
review.leaveDescription: {{count}} items have not been added to tasks or notes. Leaving does not save them.
review.newTopicDescription: The {{count}} pending items in this topic will expire without being saved.
review.generatingDescription: AI is organizing the list. You can edit and add items when it finishes.
